objective: Represent crowding as interacting states across leverage, shorting, institutional flow, ownership cadence and passive-event context instead of a single monotonic bullish/bearish score.

empiricalGuards.finding: Nominal margin balance is not a scale-free crowding measure.
empiricalGuards.evidence: TWSE 2026 market-structure analysis reports a record nominal margin-loan balance while margin-loan balance/market-cap ratio remained far below the April-2000 ratio, with market-wide maintenance and forced-liquidation indicators comparatively contained.
empiricalGuards.implication: Normalize leverage by market/stock scale and own history before calling it crowded.

empiricalGuards.finding: Two-sided leverage can represent disagreement rather than neutralization.
empiricalGuards.evidence: Taiwan short-sale research found informative short-interest effects and stronger overvaluation evidence when relative short interest interacted with high relative margin-trade levels; the historical sample/rules are not directly transferable to 2026.
empiricalGuards.implication: Do not net long leverage and short positioning into one signed number; preserve both axes and test volatility/downside separately.

empiricalGuards.evidence: Taiwan studies report stronger herding under some stress states and non-monotonic future-return effects across booms/downturns.
empiricalGuards.implication: Crowding cannot have one unconditional sign.

preferredNormalizations: balance/marketCap when PIT denominator is valid
balance/issuedShares or eligible-float proxy only with provenance
hardGuards: absolute NTD/shares alone is not crowding
falling balance alone is not forced liquidation
securities borrowing is not short sale
margin short and SBL short remain separate
dealer hedge/prop aggregation is not pure conviction
repeated daily reuse of one chipAsOfDate is not a new ownership observation
context is not a directional score
bounded membership no-event does not imply broad no-passive-flow

observableStates.definition: long-leverage level/change elevated on normalized bases
observableStates.falsification: may reflect healthy trend participation; direction requires price/flow/regime interaction

observableStates.definition: long leverage elevated/accelerating AND marginal price response weakens or downside sensitivity rises
observableStates.falsification: do not infer from high nominal balance or high financing alone

observableStates.definition: long-leverage balance falls materially on normalized basis
observableStates.falsification: does not prove margin calls/forced liquidation without maintenance/call/liquidation evidence or compatible price-volume stress

observableStates.definition: actual short-sale activity/balance elevated relative to liquidity/history
observableStates.falsification: hedging and constraints can confound; borrowing alone cannot instantiate this state

observableStates.definition: prior verified short crowding + adverse move against shorts + covering evidence + liquidity/price acceleration
observableStates.falsification: high short balance alone or covering alone is insufficient

observableStates.definition: normalized long leverage and verified short-side positioning both high
observableStates.falsification: must not be netted to neutral and must not be assumed bearish/bullish

observableStates.definition: persistent actor flow plus slow ownership concentration under provenance-complete cadence
observableStates.falsification: ownership identity and passive share unresolved; repeated weekly ownership not daily independent evidence

observableStates.definition: PIT-verified index/passive event overlaps the institutional/price-volume observation
observableStates.falsification: mechanical does not mean non-predictive; no-event requires complete scope-specific negative evidence

prohibitedComposites: margin long minus margin short as a universal crowding score
securities borrowing treated as short pressure
institutionalScore plus a duplicate passive-flow score
daily flow added directly to weekly ownership level without cadence handling
nominal margin balance ranked across eras without scale normalization
same-day repeated TDCC vintage counted as independent ownership evidence
primaryFutureTests: state frequency and transition matrix before outcomes
D1/D3/D5/D10/D20 continuation and MAE/MFE by state after data gates pass
exactNext: Do not invent a scalar crowding score. Build PIT-complete normalized inputs and first study state frequencies/transitions. LS finalized-history, TDCC vintage provenance and passive-event coverage remain independent data gates.
